title: Go-Slow Levy
tagline: Airport Road go-slow, one agbero at your window, and Uncle Chuks landing from London at 8pm.

bonus.label: Keep your cash
bonus.lostMessage: You spent your last cash, so the bonus is gone.
bonus.earnedLine: You still had your cash at the end.

short_cash.label: No money left
short_cash.tip: You can't pay your way again.

text.default: Ikeja, 6:30pm. The go-slow has turned Airport Road into a parking lot. Your Bolt hasn't moved in twenty minutes, and Uncle Chuks lands from London at 8. You're in the back seat. So is {rival}. Whoever reaches him first carries his bags, picks gifts first, and earns the right to tell the family they were the one who came through. Then, knock knock. A young man in a faded vest taps the window. Hand out. "Oga, anything for the boys?"
text.coop: Ikeja, 6:30pm. The go-slow has turned Airport Road into a parking lot. Your Bolt hasn't moved in twenty minutes, and Uncle Chuks lands from London at 8. You and {partner} are in this together. If you miss him, you'll both hear about it for ten years. Then, knock knock. A young man in a faded vest taps the window. Hand out. "Oga, anything for the boys?"
text.solo: Ikeja, 6:30pm. The go-slow has turned Airport Road into a parking lot. Your Bolt hasn't moved in twenty minutes, and Uncle Chuks lands from London at 8. If you miss him, you'll hear about it for ten years. Then, knock knock. A young man in a faded vest taps the window. Hand out. "Oga, anything for the boys?"

stakes.default: {rival} is watching. Pay too much and you're broke later. Pay nothing and this boy might remember your face.
stakes.coop: Don't let this boy waste your time. Uncle Chuks lands at 8.

choices.label: Wind down slightly, greet him like an old friend: "Chairman! How work?"
Slip him ₦500, tell him to keep the boys off your car
Wave your hand dismissively: "I'm a civil servant, I don't have money for this"
Keep the window up, quietly ask Mr. Femi who this man is

recap.default: {winner} winds down and greets him like a long-lost brother. Kayode bursts out laughing and leans on the door. {loser} sits stiff in the corner, and he notices.
recap.coop: You wind down and greet him like family. Kayode laughs and leans on the door like you two go way back.

recap.default: {winner} puts ₦500 in his palm and he nods without even looking at it. {loser} watches the money disappear and says nothing.
recap.coop: You put ₦500 in his palm and he nods without even looking at it.

recap.default: {winner} says 'government' and Kayode steps back. Then a boy by the roadside lifts his phone and starts recording. {loser} slides down in the seat.
recap.coop: You say 'government' and Kayode steps back. Then a boy by the roadside lifts his phone and starts recording.

recap.default: {winner} whispers to Mr. Femi, and Mr. Femi grins: he knows this man. {loser} kept staring at the agbero the whole time, and he saw it.
recap.coop: You whisper to Mr. Femi, and he grins: he knows this man.

recap.default: {winner} winds down and gushes “Chairman!” a little too loud. Kayode's smile goes flat. He bangs the roof, twice, and two more boys drift over.
recap.coop: You wind down and gush “Chairman!” a little too loud. Kayode's smile goes flat. He bangs the roof, twice, and two more boys drift over.

recap.default: {winner} slips him ₦500. He pockets it without looking and says, “Na for me. Now my boy too.” A second boy is already at the other window.
recap.coop: You slip him ₦500. He pockets it without looking and says, “Na for me. Now my boy too.” A second boy is already at the other window.

recap.default: {winner} waves him off with “I'm a civil servant.” “Which ministry?” Kayode asks, loudly. A phone is already up across the road.
recap.coop: You wave him off with “I'm a civil servant.” “Which ministry?” Kayode asks, loudly. A phone is already up across the road.

recap.default: {winner} whispers to Mr. Femi, but the window is cracked, and Kayode hears every word. The knocking turns into banging.
recap.coop: You whisper to Mr. Femi, but the window is cracked, and Kayode hears every word. The knocking turns into banging.

tie.recap: Nobody does anything, so Mr. Femi winds down his own window and starts talking.

kayode_talk.title: Kayode Wants To Be Your Friend
kayode_talk.text: The boy, Kayode, has leaned halfway through your window. He's telling you his life story. He sold phone accessories at Computer Village until the task force scattered his shop. Now he "manages traffic." The hold-up, he says, is a broken trailer under the bridge. Another hour minimum. Then he drops his voice: "But my guy, I know a back road through Ajao Estate. Twenty minutes to the airport. The gate people will want something small, though."

stakes.default: He's offering you an exit. But {rival} heard everything too.
stakes.coop: He's offering you an exit. Be careful how you take it.

choices.label: Laugh with him, promise you'll "settle him proper" when you get back
Give him ₦2,000 for the road and gate access

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Tell him your uncle is a big man at the airport who will "hear about this help"
Ask specifics: which gate, how many boys, how much exactly

recap.default: {winner} laughs along and promises to 'settle' him later. Kayode bangs the roof twice and sends one boy to jog ahead of the car. {loser} keeps quiet in the back.
recap.coop: You laugh along and promise to settle him later. Kayode bangs the roof twice and sends one boy to jog ahead of the car.

recap.default: {winner} gives him ₦2,000. Kayode folds it small, whistles, and the boys open the service lane for you. {loser} watches the money go.
recap.coop: You give him ₦2,000. Kayode folds it small, whistles, and the boys open the service lane for you.

recap.default: {winner} says the 'big man' line and Kayode's smile disappears. He steps away to make a call. Two minutes later an SUV is coming through the traffic.
recap.coop: You say the 'big man' line and Kayode's smile disappears. He steps away to make a call. Two minutes later an SUV is coming through the traffic.

recap.default: {winner} asks questions until Kayode runs out of answers. The 'back road' is only a gutter-side shortcut, so you decide to call Uncle Chuks first. {loser} just nods.
recap.coop: You ask questions until Kayode runs out of answers. The 'back road' is only a gutter-side shortcut, so you decide to call Uncle Chuks first.

recap.default: {winner} laughs along and promises to “settle him proper.” Kayode smells a lie. He points the way, but sends no boy ahead, so the gate people get the car cold.
recap.coop: You laugh along and promise to “settle him proper.” Kayode smells a lie. He points the way, but sends no boy ahead, so the gate people get the car cold.

recap.default: {winner} hands over ₦2,000. Kayode points at a lane without even looking. It's the service lane, and a LASTMA officer is sitting on a bike at the end of it.
recap.coop: You hand over ₦2,000. Kayode points at a lane without even looking. It's the service lane, and a LASTMA officer is sitting on a bike at the end of it.

recap.default: {winner} says the airport uncle is a big man. Kayode's eyes sharpen. “Wait.” He calls somebody, and a black SUV starts moving through the traffic toward you.
recap.coop: You say the airport uncle is a big man. Kayode's eyes sharpen. “Wait.” He calls somebody, and a black SUV starts moving through the traffic toward you.

recap.default: {winner} asks gate, number of boys, exact amount, until Mr. Femi loses patience. “Oga, I no fit again. Come down.”
recap.coop: You ask gate, number of boys, exact amount, until Mr. Femi loses patience. “Oga, I no fit again. Come down.”

tie.recap: Kayode gets tired of waiting and just waves you through. 'Go! Before I change my mind.'

second_boy.title: Boy Number Two
second_boy.text: Another boy appears at the passenger window. Bigger than Kayode, and he's not smiling. "Oga, what you gave was for Kayode. I'm holding this side." Behind him, two more boys are walking toward your boot. Mr. Femi grips the steering wheel. "Oga, this is my own car o."
second_boy.stakes: Your money is the problem now. One wrong move and this becomes a scene.

choices.label: Tell him you respect his work too: "My guy, no vex, I've already paid"
Give him ₦1,000 too, just to end it

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Call Kayode's name loud, like he's your guy: "KAYODE! Your boy is disturbing me!"
Tell Mr. Femi to inch forward slowly, keep the doors locked

recap.default: {winner} talks him down with so much respect that the boy starts laughing. 'Oga, you sabi talk.' He waves the boys away. {loser} had been holding the door lock the whole time.
recap.coop: You talk him down with so much respect that he starts laughing. 'Oga, you sabi talk.' He waves the boys away.

recap.default: {winner} gives him ₦1,000 and the boys immediately open the service lane. That is the last of {winner}'s small money. {loser} sees it.
recap.coop: You give him ₦1,000 and the boys immediately open the service lane. That is the last of your small money.

recap.default: {winner} shouts Kayode's name, and Kayode comes running with two more boys. It becomes a small argument, then a big one. Somebody calls the Chairman. {loser} wants to disappear.
recap.coop: You shout Kayode's name, and Kayode comes running with two more boys. It becomes a small argument, then a big one. Somebody calls the Chairman.

recap.default: {winner} tells Mr. Femi to creep forward, and the car edges towards a gap in the traffic that nobody else saw. Mr. Femi knows this turn. {loser} holds on to the seat.
recap.coop: You tell Mr. Femi to creep forward, and the car edges towards a gap in the traffic that nobody else saw. Mr. Femi knows this turn.

recap.default: {winner} tells the second boy “no vex, I've paid.” He says, “Na Kayode he pay, not me,” and starts knocking on every window. Mr. Femi: “Enough. Come down.”
recap.coop: You tell the second boy “no vex, I've paid.” He says, “Na Kayode he pay, not me,” and starts knocking on every window. Mr. Femi: “Enough. Come down.”

recap.default: {winner} gives him ₦1,000 and a third boy appears. With no cash left, Mr. Femi swerves into a service lane just to get away.
recap.coop: You give him ₦1,000 and a third boy appears. With no cash left, Mr. Femi swerves into a service lane just to get away.

recap.default: {winner} shouts “KAYODE!” like he's a friend. He is not. The boys turn, phones come out, and now everybody is watching.
recap.coop: You shout “KAYODE!” like he's a friend. He is not. The boys turn, phones come out, and now everybody is watching.

recap.default: {winner} tells Mr. Femi to inch forward. A boy steps in front of the bonnet. Mr. Femi brakes, hisses, and opens the door: “Come down.”
recap.coop: You tell Mr. Femi to inch forward. A boy steps in front of the bonnet. Mr. Femi brakes, hisses, and opens the door: “Come down.”

tie.recap: While everybody argues, a boy opens the service lane and waves Mr. Femi through.

viral.title: Everybody Is Watching

text.default: News travels fast. A hawker is shouting "Government! Government!" A man in a white shirt pushes to your window: "Which ministry? Show me your ID." Phones are up everywhere. Kayode is smiling like he just won a bet. {rival} is recording.
text.coop: News travels fast. A hawker is shouting "Government! Government!" A man in a white shirt pushes to your window: "Which ministry? Show me your ID." Phones are up everywhere. Kayode is smiling like he just won a bet. {partner} is staring at you, wide-eyed.
text.solo: News travels fast. A hawker is shouting "Government! Government!" A man in a white shirt pushes to your window: "Which ministry? Show me your ID." Phones are up everywhere. Kayode is smiling like he just won a bet. Nobody is looking away.

viral.stakes: This has escaped you. Get out of it before it hits WhatsApp status.

choices.label: Laugh it off: "Oga, it's a joke! I'm just enjoying myself!"
Quietly pay Kayode ₦1,000 to tell them it was a misunderstanding

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Double down: give a fake ministry and a fake name
Speak calmly: "I'm not government. My uncle is landing and I'm just in a hurry."

recap.default: {winner} laughs it off and the crowd laughs along. Somebody shouts 'Oga CEO!' and the whole road starts clapping. {loser} wishes the seat could swallow them.
recap.coop: You laugh it off and the crowd laughs along. Somebody shouts 'Oga CEO!' and the whole road starts clapping.

recap.default: {winner} quietly pays Kayode, who immediately announces: 'Na joke! The oga dey joke!' The crowd loses interest. {loser} sees ₦1,000 disappear.
recap.coop: You quietly pay Kayode, who immediately announces: 'Na joke! The oga dey joke!' The crowd loses interest.

recap.default: {winner} says 'Ministry of Works' with a straight face and a name that doesn't exist. Somebody in the crowd actually works there. Things get worse. A boy runs off to call the Chairman.
recap.coop: You say 'Ministry of Works' with a straight face and a name that doesn't exist. Somebody in the crowd actually works there. Things get worse. A boy runs off to call the Chairman.

recap.default: {winner} tells the truth in a calm voice. The man in the white shirt just shakes his head and walks away. 'Pele. Go and meet your uncle.' {loser} was still shaking.
recap.coop: You tell the truth in a calm voice. The man in the white shirt just shakes his head and walks away. 'Pele. Go and meet your uncle.'

recap.default: {winner} laughs it off. The crowd does not, and the phones get closer. Mr. Femi: “Oga, abeg come down from my car.”
recap.coop: You laugh it off. The crowd does not, and the phones get closer. Mr. Femi: “Oga, abeg come down from my car.”

recap.default: {winner} pays Kayode ₦1,000 to “explain.” He nods, then makes a call. Ten minutes later you are being waved toward the one man in charge here.
recap.coop: You pay Kayode ₦1,000 to “explain.” He nods, then makes a call. Ten minutes later you are being waved toward the one man in charge here.

recap.default: {winner} gives a fake ministry and a fake name. Somebody in the crowd googles it, reads it aloud, and everybody laughs. Mr. Femi opens the door.
recap.coop: You give a fake ministry and a fake name. Somebody in the crowd googles it, reads it aloud, and everybody laughs. Mr. Femi opens the door.

recap.default: {winner} speaks calmly, and nobody listens. Mr. Femi panics and swerves into the service lane, where a LASTMA officer is waiting.
recap.coop: You speak calmly, and nobody listens. Mr. Femi panics and swerves into the service lane, where a LASTMA officer is waiting.

tie.recap: While everybody is shouting, your phone rings. It is Uncle Chuks.

femi_gist.title: Mr. Femi Knows a Guy
femi_gist.text: Mr. Femi finally speaks. "That one is Kayode. Small boy. The real owner of this road is Chairman, and he doesn't like noise. But I know the Ajao Estate back road, I can take it. Only thing, the gate people will ask for ₦1,000 and a good story." He looks at you in the rearview mirror. "Your call, oga."
femi_gist.stakes: The driver knows the roads. What you say next decides how he feels about you.

choices.label: Tell him to take it, promise a good tip for the stress
Offer to cover the gate money and something extra for him

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Tell him to take it, say you're a doctor if anyone asks
Ask which other roads he knows, whether the main road ahead is worse than here

recap.default: {winner} promises a good tip and Mr. Femi smiles for the first time today. He swings into the estate road. {loser} says nothing.
recap.coop: You promise a good tip and Mr. Femi smiles for the first time today. He swings into the estate road.

recap.default: {winner} pays up front. Mr. Femi turns off the estate idea and takes the service lane instead. 'It dey faster, trust me.' {loser} watches the ₦1,000 go.
recap.coop: You pay up front. Mr. Femi turns off the estate idea and takes the service lane instead. 'It dey faster, trust me.'

recap.default: {winner} says 'doctor' and Mr. Femi goes quiet. 'Oga, na lie you wan tell for that gate?' He does it anyway, and word reaches the wrong ears. {loser} sits back.
recap.coop: You say 'doctor' and Mr. Femi goes quiet. 'Oga, na lie you wan tell for that gate?' He does it anyway, and word reaches the wrong ears.

recap.default: {winner} asks questions and Mr. Femi opens up about three other roads. Before he can choose, Uncle Chuks calls. {loser} listens quietly.
recap.coop: You ask questions and Mr. Femi opens up about three other roads. Before he can choose, Uncle Chuks calls.

recap.default: {winner} tells him to take the back road and promises a tip. Mr. Femi hears the “promise” and drives, quietly annoyed, to the gate with no friendly word ready.
recap.coop: You tell him to take the back road and promise a tip. Mr. Femi hears the “promise” and drives, quietly annoyed, to the gate with no friendly word ready.

recap.default: {winner} offers gate money and extra. He takes the extra first, swings left, and ends up on the service lane. “Small mistake o.”
recap.coop: You offer gate money and extra. He takes the extra first, swings left, and ends up on the service lane. “Small mistake o.”

recap.default: {winner} says “say you're a doctor.” Mr. Femi: “Doctor of which hospital?” He stops the car. “Come down.”
recap.coop: You say “say you're a doctor.” Mr. Femi: “Doctor of which hospital?” He stops the car. “Come down.”

recap.default: {winner} asks about other roads until Mr. Femi runs out of answers. Meanwhile Uncle Chuks has landed early and is calling. And calling.
recap.coop: You ask about other roads until Mr. Femi runs out of answers. Meanwhile Uncle Chuks has landed early and is calling. And calling.

tie.recap: You both stay quiet, so Mr. Femi decides alone and turns into the estate road.

banging.title: Banging
banging.text: The knocking has turned to banging. Two more boys have appeared. Mr. Femi turns to the back: "Oga, if you people don't settle this now, I'll drop you here." A trailer horn blares somewhere ahead. Nobody knows if the road has moved or not.
banging.stakes: Everything is slipping. Fix it fast before the driver abandons you.

choices.label: Wind down and apologise: "Chairman, no vex, we're rushing o!"
Give them all the cash you have just to stop the noise

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Shout back: "Do you know who you're disturbing?"
Tell Mr. Femi to drive onto the shoulder while the boys argue

recap.default: {winner} apologises, and the boys actually laugh. 'This one get respect.' They back off. {loser} just stares.
recap.coop: You apologise, and the boys actually laugh. 'This one get respect.' They back off.

recap.default: {winner} hands over almost everything in a pocket. The boys open the service lane without a word. {loser} is staring at the empty hand.
recap.coop: You hand over almost everything in your pocket. The boys open the service lane without a word.

recap.default: {winner} shouts 'Do you know who you are disturbing?' and it is a bad idea. Somebody has already called the Chairman. {loser} is trying to hide behind the headrest.
recap.coop: You shout 'Do you know who you are disturbing?' and it is a bad idea. Somebody has already called the Chairman.

recap.default: {winner} tells Mr. Femi to take the shoulder while the boys are busy arguing. The car slips out of the crowd and finds an estate road. {loser} holds the seat.
recap.coop: You tell Mr. Femi to take the shoulder while the boys are busy arguing. The car slips out of the crowd and finds an estate road.

recap.default: {winner} winds down to apologise, and a hand grabs the door. “No be apology we want.” Mr. Femi stops the car. “Come down.”
recap.coop: You wind down to apologise, and a hand grabs the door. “No be apology we want.” Mr. Femi stops the car. “Come down.”

recap.default: {winner} hands over every note. The boys take it, laugh, and keep banging. Mr. Femi says nothing, which is worse.
recap.coop: You hand over every note. The boys take it, laugh, and keep banging. Mr. Femi says nothing, which is worse.

recap.default: {winner} shouts “Do you know who you're disturbing?” A boy answers, “No, tell us.” Phones come out. Somebody starts recording.
recap.coop: You shout “Do you know who you're disturbing?” A boy answers, “No, tell us.” Phones come out. Somebody starts recording.

recap.default: {winner} tells Mr. Femi to take the shoulder. He does, and drives straight into the service lane where LASTMA is waiting.
recap.coop: You tell Mr. Femi to take the shoulder. He does, and drives straight into the service lane where LASTMA is waiting.

tie.recap: The boys leave, but the driver has had enough. 'Oga, na here I stop.'

estate_gate.title: Ajao Estate Gate
estate_gate.text: Ajao Estate. Two security men and one boy with a long stick. The gate is chained and nobody is hurrying. "Who are you going to see?" You can see the airport road on the other side of the fence.
estate_gate.stakes: This gate is the only thing between you and a faster road. Use your head.

choices.label: Greet them in Yoruba, say you're visiting "Aunty in Block C"
Give them ₦1,000 gate fee, no story

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Say the estate chairman is Mr. Femi's cousin
Ask for the visitor register, write a real name inside

recap.default: {winner} greets them in Yoruba and one of the security men smiles. 'Aunty Block C? Wait, let me open.' The chain comes off. {loser} sits quietly.
recap.coop: You greet them in Yoruba and one of the security men smiles. 'Aunty Block C? Wait, let me open.' The chain comes off.

recap.default: {winner} pays ₦1,000. They open the gate, but nobody has change for the ₦500 balance, and it takes ten minutes of arguing before the car moves. {loser} watches the clock.
recap.coop: You pay ₦1,000. They open the gate, but nobody has change for the ₦500 balance, and it takes ten minutes of arguing before the car moves.

recap.default: {winner} says 'estate chairman'. The security man laughs, picks up his phone and calls the real chairman, who has never heard of Mr. Femi. But the gate opens anyway, and somebody is shouting behind you. {loser} sees the whole thing.
recap.coop: You say 'estate chairman'. The security man laughs, picks up his phone and calls the real chairman, who has never heard of Mr. Femi. But the gate opens anyway, and somebody is shouting behind you.

recap.default: {winner} writes a real name in the register and the security men are impressed. 'This one get sense.' The gate opens. {loser} looks at the register and says nothing.
recap.coop: You write a real name in the register and the security men are impressed. 'This one get sense.' The gate opens.

recap.default: {winner} greets in Yoruba, but the guard asks, “Aunty in Block C? Which Aunty?” The gate opens only after twenty minutes of explaining.
recap.coop: You greet in Yoruba, but the guard asks, “Aunty in Block C? Which Aunty?” The gate opens only after twenty minutes of explaining.

recap.default: {winner} hands over ₦1,000. “Gate fee is ₦2,000 o.” The extra comes out and the gate opens, slowly.
recap.coop: You hand over ₦1,000. “Gate fee is ₦2,000 o.” The extra comes out and the gate opens, slowly.

recap.default: {winner} says the chairman is Mr. Femi's cousin. The guard calls the actual chairman. He is nobody's cousin. One man follows the car on foot, shouting into his phone.
recap.coop: You say the chairman is Mr. Femi's cousin. The guard calls the actual chairman. He is nobody's cousin. One man follows the car on foot, shouting into his phone.

recap.default: {winner} writes a real name in the register and waits while they confirm it. The gate opens, an hour late.
recap.coop: You write a real name in the register and wait while they confirm it. The gate opens, an hour late.

tie.recap: Nobody wins. The guards finally open the gate after ten minutes, only because they are tired of looking at you.

service_lane.title: LASTMA
service_lane.text: You're on the service lane, moving past everybody, until a man in a green LASTMA vest jumps in front of the car. "Oga, you're driving against traffic. Park there. Park!" He's already writing in his small booklet.
service_lane.stakes: He has your number plate. Make sure this ticket doesn't become a bigger problem.

choices.label: Beg with respect: "Oga, my uncle is landing, it's an emergency"
Slide ₦2,000 under the booklet: "For your water, sir"

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Say you're a doctor rushing to see a patient
Admit the mistake, ask for the fastest legal way out

recap.default: {winner} begs well, and the officer hears 'uncle landing from London' and softens. 'Next time, use the main road. Go.' {loser} is still holding their breath.
recap.coop: You beg well, and the officer hears 'uncle landing from London' and softens. 'Next time, use the main road. Go.'

recap.default: {winner} slides ₦2,000 under the booklet. It disappears. The officer waves the car off, but his partner on the other side of the road saw everything and is already taking out a phone. {loser} sinks into the seat.
recap.coop: You slide ₦2,000 under the booklet. It disappears. The officer waves you off, but his partner on the other side of the road saw everything and is already taking out a phone.

recap.default: {winner} says 'doctor'. The officer asks which hospital. {winner} says a name. He writes it down and says he will check. You are free to go, but you are now on a list. {loser} grips the seat.
recap.coop: You say 'doctor'. The officer asks which hospital. You say a name. He writes it down and says he will check. You are free to go, but you are now on a list.

recap.default: {winner} takes the ticket without a fight. It takes ten minutes, but he points the car to the quickest legal way back to the main road. No stress. {loser} is still sweating.
recap.coop: You take the ticket without a fight. It takes ten minutes, but he points you to the quickest legal way back to the main road. No stress.

recap.default: {winner} begs respectfully. The officer listens, writes anyway, lets the car go. You'll pay the fine later.
recap.coop: You beg respectfully. The officer listens, writes anyway, lets the car go. You'll pay the fine later.

recap.default: {winner} slides ₦2,000 under the booklet. He takes it, then writes the ticket anyway. “For your water, and for the offence.”
recap.coop: You slide ₦2,000 under the booklet. He takes it, then writes the ticket anyway. “For your water, and for the offence.”

recap.default: {winner} says doctor. The officer asks which hospital. He takes the keys and walks off. It takes begging, arguing and a long wait to get them back.
recap.coop: You say doctor. The officer asks which hospital. He takes the keys and walks off. It takes begging, arguing and a long wait to get them back.

recap.default: {winner} admits the mistake and asks for the fastest legal way out. He gives it, and it is not fast.
recap.coop: You admit the mistake and ask for the fastest legal way out. He gives it, and it is not fast.

tie.recap: Neither of you convinces him. He gets a call, waves you off and goes to deal with something else. You lose ten minutes.

chairman.title: The Chairman Himself

text.default: An SUV blocks the road. A man steps out in a clean agbada: the boys called him. "Who is the one disrespecting my boys?" The go-slow goes quiet. Everybody wants to see what happens next. {rival} is still in the car, watching to see if you sink or swim.
text.coop: An SUV blocks the road. A man steps out in a clean agbada: the boys called him. "Who is the one disrespecting my boys?" The go-slow goes quiet. Everybody wants to see what happens next. {partner} grips your sleeve, watching to see if you sink or swim.
text.solo: An SUV blocks the road. A man steps out in a clean agbada: the boys called him. "Who is the one disrespecting my boys?" The go-slow goes quiet. Everybody wants to see what happens next. Mr. Femi stays in the driver's seat, watching to see if you sink or swim.

chairman.stakes: Everyone on this road is watching. Handle this with respect.

choices.label: Greet him with both hands, call him "Chairman," bend slightly
Settle him with ₦5,000 "for the boys' drinks"

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Drop big names: "I know the Commissioner, ask anybody!"
Speak very little, let Mr. Femi talk since he knows Chairman's people

recap.default: {winner} greets him with both hands, and the Chairman is flattered. 'This one get home training.' He orders the boys to open a lane for the car. {loser} watches with their mouth open.
recap.coop: You greet him with both hands, and the Chairman is flattered. 'This one get home training.' He orders the boys to open a lane for the car.

recap.default: {winner} gives ₦5,000. The Chairman keeps them for another fifteen minutes asking about their family and where they come from before he lets them go. {loser} checks the time again and again.
recap.coop: You give ₦5,000. The Chairman keeps you for another fifteen minutes asking about your family and where you come from before he lets you go.

recap.default: {winner} drops the Commissioner's name. The Chairman smiles and says, 'Oh? Let me call him now.' He is already dialing. The lane opens quickly, and you are gone before he gets through, but the boys are shouting behind you. {loser} just breathes.
recap.coop: You drop the Commissioner's name. The Chairman smiles and says, 'Oh? Let me call him now.' He is already dialing. The lane opens quickly, and you are gone before he gets through, but the boys are shouting behind you.

recap.default: {winner} says nothing. Mr. Femi talks, a name is mentioned, and the Chairman nods slowly. 'Ah. You people should have said.' It takes time, but the lane opens. {loser} still has not said a word.
recap.coop: You say nothing. Mr. Femi talks, a name is mentioned, and the Chairman nods slowly. 'Ah. You people should have said.' It takes time, but the lane opens.

recap.default: {winner} greets him with both hands. He stays quiet a moment too long, then lets you pass, with a boy sitting in the back seat “for the road.”
recap.coop: You greet him with both hands. He stays quiet a moment too long, then lets you pass, with a boy sitting in the back seat “for the road.”

recap.default: {winner} hands him ₦5,000 “for the boys' drinks.” He takes it, then says, “And mine?” It takes everything left to be released.
recap.coop: You hand him ₦5,000 “for the boys' drinks.” He takes it, then says, “And mine?” It takes everything left to be released.

recap.default: {winner} drops the Commissioner's name. The Chairman smiles. “He is my brother.” His boys escort the car out, and one keeps the plate number on his phone.
recap.coop: You drop the Commissioner's name. The Chairman smiles. “He is my brother.” His boys escort the car out, and one keeps the plate number on his phone.

recap.default: {winner} stays quiet and let Mr. Femi talk. He talks too much. By the time the Chairman waves you through, it's very late.
recap.coop: You stay quiet and let Mr. Femi talk. He talks too much. By the time the Chairman waves you through, it's very late.

tie.recap: Nobody convinces him. He just gets bored, gets back in his SUV and the boys let the road open, slowly.

okada.title: Come Down Here
okada.text: Mr. Femi drops you at a bus stop near the airport and drives off. Okada men surround you immediately. "Oga, airport? ₦3,000!" You have fifteen minutes to find a ride and look presentable when you see your uncle.
okada.stakes: You're on your own now. Choose your ride carefully, don't waste time.

choices.label: Bargain: "Oga, ₦1,500 and I'll tip you if you're fast"
Pay ₦3,000 flat, no argument

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Tell him you're a big man's brother and it's an emergency
Look for a rider who knows quiet side streets, ask him directly

recap.default: {winner} bargains hard, and a rider agrees at ₦1,800. He is not in a rush, but he is honest. {loser} climbs on behind another rider and holds on tight.
recap.coop: You bargain hard, and a rider agrees at ₦1,800. He is not in a rush, but he is honest.

recap.default: {winner} pays ₦3,000 flat. The rider shoots through every gap in the traffic like he owns the road. {loser} watches {winner}'s bike disappear.
recap.coop: You pay ₦3,000 flat. The rider shoots through every gap in the traffic like he owns the road.

recap.default: {winner} says 'big man's brother'. The rider smiles, takes off and goes through a red light. A police van is waiting. {loser} is shouting at the other rider to hurry.
recap.coop: You say 'big man's brother'. The rider smiles, takes off and goes through a red light. A police van is waiting.

recap.default: {winner} finds the rider who knows the side streets and gets there fast without any stress. {loser} is stuck in the main road traffic.
recap.coop: You find the rider who knows the side streets and get there fast without any stress.

recap.default: {winner} bargains, but the rider hears “tip” and doubles his speed and his price. It is rough, expensive, and a little late.
recap.coop: You bargain, but the rider hears “tip” and doubles his speed and his price. It is rough, expensive, and a little late.

recap.default: {winner} pays ₦3,000 flat. The rider takes a side street, loses signal and has to ask directions, then a police checkpoint stops the bike.
recap.coop: You pay ₦3,000 flat. The rider takes a side street, loses signal and has to ask directions, then a police checkpoint stops the bike.

recap.default: {winner} says “big man's brother.” The rider laughs, asks the big man's name, and doesn't believe the answer. A checkpoint stops the bike.
recap.coop: You say “big man's brother.” The rider laughs, asks the big man's name, and doesn't believe the answer. A checkpoint stops the bike.

recap.default: {winner} asks the rider about quiet streets. He says he knows them all, and gets lost in two.
recap.coop: You ask the rider about quiet streets. He says he knows them all, and gets lost in two.

tie.recap: Nobody wins. You both take whatever bike comes first, and it is slow.

uncle_call.title: Where Una Dey?
uncle_call.text: Your phone rings. It's Uncle Chuks. He's landed. "I'm here o! Where are you people? I bought new phones for you and you're not here yet!" You can hear the airport behind his voice, and he's not happy.
uncle_call.stakes: How you answer this call decides what mood he's in when you see him.

choices.label: Sweet-talk him: "Uncle, my Uncle! The London glow is in your voice!"
Offer to book him a Bolt right now: "Uncle, I'll send a car for you"

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Tell him you're at the gate already, "just two minutes"
Tell him the truth: go-slow, thirty minutes, wait at a cafe and buy something

recap.default: {winner} sweet-talks him until he is laughing. 'You this boy! Okay, I go wait.' He takes a selfie at the airport pillar and sends it. {loser} is quiet on the other side of the car.
recap.coop: You sweet-talk him until he is laughing. 'You this boy! Okay, I go wait.' He takes a selfie at the airport pillar and sends it.

recap.default: {winner} orders a car for him. Uncle Chuks is impressed, but the driver gets lost and he is annoyed again by the time you reach him. {loser} looks at the road.
recap.coop: You order a car for him. Uncle Chuks is impressed, but the driver gets lost and he is annoyed again by the time you reach him.

recap.default: {winner} says 'I'm at the gate'. Uncle Chuks says, 'Which gate? I dey look gate.' He walks out to look for you, and he is not smiling. {loser} sighs.
recap.coop: You say 'I'm at the gate'. Uncle Chuks says, 'Which gate? I dey look gate.' He walks out to look for you, and he is not smiling.

recap.default: {winner} tells him the truth. He sighs, 'Okay. Wait, let me get something to eat.' He is calm when you arrive. {loser} sits quietly.
recap.coop: You tell him the truth. He sighs, 'Okay. Wait, let me get something to eat.' He is calm when you arrive.

recap.default: {winner} sweet-talks Uncle Chuks, but the line is bad, and he only hears “go-slow.” Two voice notes arrive. Neither is polite.
recap.coop: You sweet-talk Uncle Chuks, but the line is bad, and he only hears “go-slow.” Two voice notes arrive. Neither is polite.

recap.default: {winner} offers to send a Bolt. Uncle Chuks takes the offer and the Bolt arrives to find him already moving. He is not happy.
recap.coop: You offer to send a Bolt. Uncle Chuks takes the offer and the Bolt arrives to find him already moving. He is not happy.

recap.default: {winner} says “I'm at the gate already.” Uncle Chuks calls someone at the gate, who says no. The lie is out before you arrive.
recap.coop: You say “I'm at the gate already.” Uncle Chuks calls someone at the gate, who says no. The lie is out before you arrive.

recap.default: {winner} tells him the truth. He sighs, orders coffee, and says he'll wait. But he'll remember how late you were.
recap.coop: You tell him the truth. He sighs, orders coffee, and says he'll wait. But he'll remember how late you were.

tie.recap: You both say something and the call ends badly. He says he will wait, but he will not forget.

arrivals_clean.title: Arrivals: He Is Smiling
arrivals_clean.text: You push through the sliding doors. Uncle Chuks is by a pillar, trolley full, big smile, arms already open. He shouts your name loud enough for everybody to hear. Now the real test: how you greet him.

stakes.default: Hug him first and you pick gifts first.

choices.label: Run to hug him: "Uncle! Welcome home!"
Grab the trolley handle and start pushing for him
Tell him he hasn't changed, "You even look younger!"
Ask about his flight, his health, and his bags, like a grown person

arrivals_late.title: Arrivals: He Is Annoyed
arrivals_late.text: You arrive late. Uncle Chuks is sitting on his box, arms crossed, phone in hand. "You people have tired me o. Two hours I've been waiting." People around you are already looking. You need to fix this fast.

stakes.default: Hug him first, but pay for the delay.

choices.label: Apologise sweetly: "Uncle, abeg no vex, traffic was a problem"
Buy him food and a cold drink from the airport shop right now

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Say your car broke down and you ran the last part
Say sorry and mean it, then carry his heavy bag without being asked

arrivals_wahala.title: Arrivals: Trouble Followed You
arrivals_wahala.text: You made it in time, but trouble followed you. Someone from the road is at the arrivals gate watching you, and Uncle Chuks has noticed. "Who is that one? Why is he looking at you like that?" You have seconds to explain.

stakes.default: Hug him first and keep this trouble away from him.
stakes.coop: Keep Uncle Chuks out of this mess.

choices.label: Laugh it off: "Uncle, that's an old friend. Let's go, I'm hungry!"
Quickly steer him and the trolley toward the car park
Say the man is a church friend who was just surprised to see you
Give him the short honest version: "Small road trouble. All good. Let's go."

endings.win: You reach Uncle Chuks first. He hugs you, hands you a shopping bag, and tells everyone within shouting distance that you're his "good pikin." {loser} carries the small bag. At Christmas, the family will hear your name.
endings.loss: By the time you arrive, {winner} is already hugging Uncle Chuks and pushing the trolley. You carry the small bag. The drive home is silent.

success.default: You reach him together, tired and sweating, and he hugs you both. He says he's never seen two people so happy to see an airport.
success.solo: You reach him tired and sweating, and he hugs you tight. He says he's never seen someone so happy to see an airport.

fail.default: By the time you reach arrivals, Uncle Chuks has already taken a taxi. He will remind you every Christmas.
fail.solo: By the time you reach arrivals, Uncle Chuks has already taken a taxi. He will remind you every Christmas.

epilogues.text: Kayode calls Mr. Femi the next day to ask if you reached safely. You have a friend on Airport Road now.
Kayode still remembers your face. Avoid Airport Road for a while.
Your ₦500 has circulated the boys' WhatsApp group. Everyone knows you pay.
You check your pocket that night and almost cry.
The video of you shouting "government" on Airport Road is still circulating two days later.
Mr. Femi saves your number. Next time he'll come for you himself.
Mr. Femi gives you one star and a very long comment.
You know the Ajao Estate back road now, and you're not telling anybody.
